caption_a:
Peter Steele didn't write love songs — he wrote autopsies of the heart set to doom tempo.
This Type O Negative hoodie is soaked in that same Brooklyn darkness — the green-black aesthetic of a man who made depression sound like a cathedral organ played through a wall of Marshalls.

caption_b:
He stood six foot eight in a world built for smaller men, and he sang about loving you to death like it was a promise he intended to keep.
This hoodie carries the ghost frequency of October Rust — Peter Steele's baritone fossilized in fabric, a love letter written in funeral ink.
Some things are too beautiful to survive. Wear them anyway.

etsy_description:
Pour one out for the King of Gothic Doom — this Type O Negative hoodie is a tribute to the towering legacy of Peter Steele and the band that turned heartbreak into a genre. Drenched in the iconic green-black aesthetic that defined albums like Bloody Kisses and October Rust, this gothic pullover is mourning wear for the romantically doomed.

Made from premium heavyweight fleece, this hoodie delivers the warmth that Peter's baritone once provided — deep, enveloping, and slightly dangerous. The dark art design captures the essence of gothic doom metal: equal parts beauty, despair, and dark humor that only Type O fans truly understand.

Whether you're spinning Black No. 1 on vinyl or just need the world to know where your allegiance lies, this metalhead sweatshirt is your statement piece. Pair it with black everything, a dry sense of humor, and the understanding that love is just death in a better outfit.

Unisex fit. Multiple sizes available. Designed and printed in the USA. For the select few who know that the best metal comes from Brooklyn.
